Stockfish.js 19.0.1 lite single-threaded build

The files in this directory are unmodified from the npm package stockfish@19.0.1
(https://www.npmjs.com/package/stockfish, https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/releases/tag/v19.0.1).
